Brief-claimed-by: session_01ADHkmPVvKkogo96sJpUuyB · batch #438 · 2026-11-01T10:19Z

Director seat (summon #55). Presented to the maintainer in batch #438 (three items: #28590, #28105, #27855). The card's own facets, options and recommendation are the reading; the seat's increment:

- **Premise re-read** on `origin/main` `35b178bd0a`: `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_CHANGED` (`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-provider-errors.ts:141–162`, the ruling on #27401, comment 6545635244) is the fourth outcome: the materializer degrades the instance naming each changed or missing tool, re-checks it on the outage backoff, recovers when the server serves the pinned definition again, and an edited pin re-materializes at once. PR #28515 (+1114/−42, merged 2026-11-01T06:20Z) shipped it. The parent's Done-when (#27293 body) already defers the MCP half to this card.
- **Facets, read by this seat:** ① only B gives `sha256` one meaning on every listing, document or pin set; A and C open a permanent "not applicable" arm that no gate reads. ② The pull today is cloud's first shelf (3–4 apps under ruling 6486157794): real, bounded. ③ A and C leave the tool drift the pin was built to catch silent on exactly the apps that reach administrators; under B it degrades with a named reason. ④ B's cost is one pin set per MCP app, produced by `computeMcpToolsSnapshot`, refreshed when the vendor changes a tool on purpose.
- **Workload** (the card carries no column): B = the epic PM amends #27293's Done-when (text) + one pin card for `connector-github` in the shelf app's repo (digests measured against the live server; mechanism precedent PR #28515, no shelf-pin precedent). A and C = a Done-when amendment only.
- **Recommendation: B.** Only ① is needed to reach it; ②③④ do not turn it. One execution parameter to rule in the same stroke: the listing's `sha256` is the digest of the pin set as the MCP app ships it, and a degraded instance is the shelf's signal to re-pin, ⛔ never a reason to drop the pin. Not taken: A (a declared field with no enforcement), C (narrows the acceptance to hide the gap).
- **Blind spot:** the shelf apps' repository is not attached to this session; the pin card's lane and repo are the epic PM's to name.

director#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPVvKkogo96sJpUuyB

Ruling: batch #438 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「28590 27855 同意」 2026-11-01T10:29Z

Director seat (summon #55; brief-claimed above in 6556647778, presented in the summon chat). The maintainer answered two items of the batch verbatim: 「28590 27855 同意」 = each at the seat's recommendation, so this card's letter is **B, pin then hash the pin**.

**What the ruling binds (letter B):**
- An MCP connector app on the shelf ships `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` for every tool it includes. The listing's three provenance fields for an MCP app are: `upstream` = the server URL, `commit` = the package commit, `sha256` = the digest of that pin set as the app ships it.
- #27293's Done-when is amended to say so for MCP apps; for an app that packages a vendor document the three fields keep their meaning (document source URL, upstream commit, sha256 of the packaged bytes).
- Execution parameter ruled in the same stroke: a degraded instance (`CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_CHANGED`, `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-provider-errors.ts:141–162`, PR #28515) is the shelf's signal to re-pin and re-publish, ⛔ never a reason to drop the pin or to mark `sha256` not applicable.
- Not taken: A (`sha256` "not applicable" for MCP), C (provenance only where a document is packaged).

**Workload of the letter:** the epic PM of #27293 amends the parent's Done-when (text, this repository) and files one pin card for `connector-github` in the shelf app's repository (digests measured against the live server; mechanism precedent PR #28515, +1114/−42; no shelf-pin precedent). `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · no `packages/spec/**` change.

**Execution:** the epic PM (`epic:#27293`) picks this card up with `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment, amends the Done-when, files the pin card, and closes this decision card; the `needs-user-decision` → closed stroke is that seat's. The `Ruled:` body line is written by this act.

epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Ruling-ref: 6556740185

Executed: the ruling is letter B. In this act:

1. **#27293's Done-when is amended.** For an MCP app, `upstream` is the server URL, `commit` is the package commit, and `sha256` is the digest of the `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` pin set the app ships. A degraded `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_CHANGED` instance means re-pin and re-publish, never drop the pin. A document-packaging app keeps its meaning: source URL, upstream commit, sha256 of the packaged bytes.
2. **Pin card filed:** #28647 (`connector-github` pins `search_issues` and `issue_read`, with digests measured against the live server), a child of #27293. The shelf app lives in this repository (`packages/apps/connector-github`), so it stays in this repository and lane.
3. **This card** is closed `completed`, and `needs-user-decision` is removed. `pm:epic` is kept.
